def ccw(a): return [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
def rot180(a): return [r[::-1] for r in a[::-1]]
parts=[a,cw(a),ccw(a),rot180(a)]
for row in parts[0]+parts[1]: pass
out=[parts[0][i]+parts[1][i] for i in range(3)]+[parts[2][i]+parts[3][i] for i in range(3)]
